summary: The Major Design Support Center of the College of Liberal Studies is holding the 2026 Multiple-Major Essay Contest on undergraduates' experiences of completing a multiple major. Eligible students (third year or above, including those on leave) and graduates with multiple-major experience may apply and submit their essays through SNU비교과 (SNU Extracurricular) by Sunday, 22 November 2026. Participation is optional.
applies_to: Optional. Open to enrolled undergraduates of this university in their third year or above (including students on leave of absence) and graduates, who have multiple-major experience during their undergraduate studies at this university. Multiple majors include double majors, minors, joint (interdisciplinary) majors, linked majors and student-designed majors.
conditions: Only students in their third year or above (including those on leave) and graduates may enter.
Entrants must have multiple-major experience during undergraduate studies at this university: a double major, minor, joint major, linked major or student-designed major.
Applications and essays must be submitted through SNU비교과 (SNU Extracurricular).
steps: Read the attached contest poster ([학부대학 전공설계지원센터] 2026 다전공 수기 공모전 포스터.pdf); its content was not read for this translation.
Find the contest post on SNU비교과 (SNU Extracurricular) by following the link in the original notice or searching for "2026 다전공 수기 공모전: 꼬리에 꼬리를 무는 나의 다전공 이야기".
Apply for the contest and submit your essay through that SNU비교과 post by Sunday, 22 November 2026.
translation:
The Major Design Support Center of the College of Liberal Studies is holding the "2026 Multiple-Major Essay Contest – My Multiple-Major Story, One Tale Leading to Another" [2026 다전공 수기 공모전 - 꼬리에 꼬리를 무는 나의 다전공 이야기]. We welcome stories of the concerns, learning and growth you experienced while choosing and completing a multiple major. We hope many students will take part.

A. Contest overview
○ Theme: Undergraduates' experiences of completing a multiple major
○ Eligibility: Enrolled students in their third year or above (including students on leave of absence) and graduates who have multiple-major experience during their undergraduate studies at this university
※ Multiple major [다전공]: double major [복수전공], minor [부전공], joint major [연합전공], linked major [연계전공], student-designed major [학생설계전공]
○ Submission deadline: Sunday, 22 November 2026

B. How to participate: Apply and submit your essay on SNU비교과 (SNU Extracurricular).
※ Link to the SNU비교과 post ▶ 2026 다전공 수기 공모전: 꼬리에 꼬리를 무는 나의 다전공 이야기 (the link is in the original notice)
※ Search on SNU비교과 ▶ 2026 다전공 수기 공모전: 꼬리에 꼬리를 무는 나의 다전공 이야기

Attachment: 2026 Multiple-Major Essay Contest poster
Attached file (1): [학부대학 전공설계지원센터] 2026 다전공 수기 공모전 포스터.pdf (1 MB). The content of this attachment was not read for this translation.
